gaps: Deliveroo — ops only: rating/prep/open-hours present, but NO sales row this week (no Tax Invoice PDF filed and no Weekly Summary row)

issues: Covers rose by 82 (7.37%) week on week while spend per head fell £0.60 (2.80%), which the site puts down to the free ramen and £5 ramen offers.
Sales were up £1,053.02 (4.29%) week on week and finished £2,096.79 (8.92%) above target.
Food cost was 30.44%, driven by guests choosing seafood or steak ramen on the offers, food mistakes by new FOH staff and a lot of waste.
Deliveroo is on a red light for missed items and late preparation, and Deliveroo sales are going down.
The Google rating for the week was 5.00.
Steak tataki, Hell ramen and yuzu tom yum showed white residue, and the supplier has been queried as the cause.
Chicken karaage portions are causing waste.
Customers complained of cold curry sauce, and two tables had cold ramen on Saturday when BOH was understaffed.
Egg presentation is poor and a new egg supplier is being sought.
The side ticket printer is causing problems.
Michael flagged that food quality is low.
There were two complaints of chewy squid and one of sushi not being fresh, which the Head Chef attributed to the factory.
BOH compliance has been missed and the Head Chef committed to start it on Tuesday.
A 1 star review was put down to understaffing and was posted on the wrong venue.
Hassan has been dismissed from BOH and Saurav is to be hired, training on both sushi and hot sections.
The Head Chef has chosen Joshua for the Chef DP position and requested a KP from 2pm to close, or FOH able to cover KP when busy.
BOH labour was reduced this week.
FOH needs training to be more efficient, managers need more Kobas training and the Irasshaimase greeting must be consistent.
The EPOS still needs updating with lunch menu surcharges.
Freshers takes place on 29 September.
